courses.title: Madinah Arabic Book 1: Complete Breakdown
courses.description: Comprehensive step-by-step video lecture series covering Dr. V. Abdur Rahim's world-renowned Madinah Book 1. Ideal for absolute beginners learning sentence structure, noun cases, and vocabulary.
courses.instructor: Shaykh Dr. V. Abdur Rahim & Ustadh Asif Meherali
courses.syllabus: ["Lesson 1: Demonstrative Pronouns (Haza / Dhalika)","Lesson 2: Definite vs Indefinite Nouns (Al-Ta'reef)","Lesson 3: Solar & Lunar Letters (Al-Huruf Ash-Shamsiyyah)","Lesson 4: Prepositions (Huruf Al-Jarr)","Lesson 5: Possession & Construct (Idhafah)"]

courses.title: Al-Ajrumiyyah Masterclass (شرح الآجرومية)
courses.titleArabic: شرح المقدمة الآجرومية في علم العربية
courses.description: In-depth scholarly study of the classical primer 'Al-Muqaddimah Al-Ajrumiyyah'. Learn the core foundations of Arabic syntax, case markers, marfoo'at, mansoobat, and majroorat.
courses.syllabus: ["Types of Speech (Kalam, Ism, Fi'l, Harf)","Marks of I'rab (Dhammah, Fat-hah, Kasrah, Sukun)","Substitutes in I'rab (Waw, Alif, Ya, Nun)","Af'al (Past, Present, Imperative) and their rulers","Marfoo'at of Nouns (Faa'il, Mubtada, Khabar)"]

courses.title: Quranic Arabic Grammar from Scratch
courses.description: Designed specifically for students seeking direct comprehension of the Holy Quran. Connect grammatical concepts with direct Quranic ayaat examples.
courses.syllabus: ["The 4 Properties of Ism: Status, Number, Gender, Type","Fragments: Idafah, Mawsoof Sifah, Harf Jarr, Harf Nasb","Sentences: Jumlah Ismiyyah and Jumlah Fi'liyyah","Quranic Rhetorical Nuances (Balaghah introduction)"]

courses.title: Sarf Made Easy: Ilm us-Seegha
courses.description: Thorough exploration of Arabic morphology in Urdu. Master the 10 trilateral verb scales, regular and irregular roots (mu'tal, muda'af, mahmooz), and morphophonemic shifts.
courses.syllabus: ["Thulaathi Mujarrad (6 Abwaab)","Thulaathi Mazeed Feeh (Forms 2 through 10)","Ta'leelat: Rules of Hamzah and Weak Letters","Ism Faa'il, Ism Maf'ool, and Ism Taafeeq derivation"]

courses.title: Arabic Morphology: Foundations of Sarf (সহজ সরফ)
courses.description: A lucid and accessible introduction to Arabic word derivations and verb patterns taught in Bengali. Ideal for students in Bangladesh, West Bengal, and the Bengali diaspora.
courses.syllabus: ["শব্দ ও রূপমূলের ধারণা (Root & Pattern Concept)","মাযী ও মুযারে এর গর্দান (Past & Present Conjugation)","আম্‌র ও নাহী গঠন (Imperatives & Prohibitions)","নিয়মিত ও অনিয়মিত ধাতুর রূপান্তর"]

courses.title: Al-Nahw Al-Wadih: Primary to Secondary
courses.description: The modern standard Egyptian curriculum that has trained generations of Arabists worldwide. Taught entirely in clear, classical Arabic with extensive drill exercises.
courses.syllabus: ["Al-Jumlah Al-Mufeedah & Ajza' Al-Jumlah","Taqseem Al-Fi'l bi I'tibar Zamanihi","Al-Mubtada wal Khabar & Inna / Kaana","Nawasib and Jawazim of Al-Fi'l Al-Mudari'"]

courses.title: Al-Balaghah Al-Wadihah Explained
courses.description: Advanced study of Arabic rhetoric: Bayan (Metaphor & Simile), Ma'ani (Semantic meanings & Sentence emphasis), and Badi' (Stylistic embellishments). Essential for Quranic appreciation.
courses.instructor: Dr. Ayman Swayd & Dr. Taha Jabir
courses.syllabus: ["Ilm al-Bayan: At-Tashbeeh (Simile) & Al-Majaz (Metaphor)","Al-Isti'arah: Tasreehiyyah and Makniyyah","Ilm al-Ma'ani: Al-Khabar wal Insha', Al-Qasr, Al-Ijaz wal Itnab","Ilm al-Badi': At-Tabaq, Al-Jinas, As-Saj'"]

courses.title: Spoken Arabic for Daily Life & Travel
courses.description: Learn active conversational Modern Standard Arabic for everyday dialogues, travel, shopping, asking directions, and social greetings.
courses.syllabus: ["Greetings, Introductions, and Courtesy Expressions","At the Airport, Hotel, and Taxi","Dining at Restaurants & Ordering Food","Numbers, Currencies, and Bargaining in the Souq"]

courses.title: Qisas an-Nabiyyeen Guided Reading Practice
courses.titleArabic: قراءة في قصص النبيين لأبي الحسن الندوي
courses.description: Bridge the gap between grammar rules and reading actual Arabic literature. Read and parse sentences from the timeless classic by Abul Hasan Ali Nadwi.
courses.syllabus: ["Story of Sayyiduna Ibrahim (AS) - Part 1","Grammatical breakdown of complex past verbs","Story of Sayyiduna Yusuf (AS) - Sentence nuances","Vocabulary expansion and idiomatic expressions"]

courses.title: Shatha al-Arf fi Fann al-Sarf
courses.titleArabic: شذا العرف في فن الصرف للحملاوي
courses.description: Comprehensive classical treatise on advanced Arabic morphology by Ahmad al-Hamalawi. Explores rare scales, phonetic assimilations (Idgham), and poetic licenses.
courses.syllabus: ["Taqseem Al-Fi'l ila Saheeh wa Mu'tal","Al-Mujarrad wal Mazeed Al-Rubaa'i","Ahkam Al-I'lal wal Ibdal","Al-Waqf and Tashkeel an-Nusoos"]

learning_paths.title: Quranic Arabic Fluency Track
learning_paths.titleArabic: مسار فقه وفهم لغة القرآن الكريم
learning_paths.description: A structured, milestone-driven curriculum designed to take a complete beginner to direct understanding of 85%+ of the Quran's linguistic structures and classical nuances.

learning_paths.title: Classical Arabic Scholar Track
learning_paths.titleArabic: مسار النحوي المتخصص في علوم اللسان
learning_paths.description: The rigorous traditional curriculum followed in Islamic institutions worldwide, covering classical Nahw, intricate Sarf, and the branches of Balagha.

path_sections.title: Stage 1: Script, Vocabulary & Foundations
path_sections.description: Master phonetic pronunciation, essential conversational expressions, and the fundamental building blocks of Arabic words.

path_sections.title: Stage 2: Core Grammar (Nahw) & Verb Forms (Sarf)
path_sections.titleArabic: المرحلة الثانية: قواعد النحو وتصريف الأفعال
path_sections.description: Internalize the 4 properties of the noun, basic sentence diagrams, and the 10 trilateral verb derivations.

path_sections.title: Stage 3: Applied Text Analysis & Rhetoric
path_sections.titleArabic: المرحلة الثالثة: الإعراب التطبيقي والبلاغة القرآنية
path_sections.description: Direct grammatical parsing of prophetic narratives, surahs from the Quran, and introduction to Arabic eloquence.

path_sections.title: Section 1: Structural Foundations & The Sentence
path_sections.titleArabic: المبحث الأول: أسس التركيب والجملة العربية
path_sections.description: Deconstructing speech into nominal and verbal sentences with complete rules.

path_sections.title: Section 2: Morphological Mastery (Sarf)
path_sections.titleArabic: المبحث الثاني: دقائق علم الصرف والعلل
path_sections.description: Mastery of roots, weak verbs (mu'tallat), defective letters, and derivations.

path_sections.title: Section 3: Higher Rhetoric & Balaghah
path_sections.description: Investigating Bayan, Ma'ani, and Badi' for profound linguistic literary analysis.

path_courses.customNotes: Build conversational intuition and active recall before diving into formal grammatical analysis.
Work through every exercise thoroughly; write all sentences with full harakat.
Pay careful attention to the 4 status markers (Raf', Nasb, Jarr, Jazm) in Quranic verses.
Recommended companion for mastering the 10 verb forms (awzan) and morphological tables.
Read aloud to develop fluency in parsing continuous unvowelled classical prose.
The golden standard for understanding the reasons behind every case ending in Arabic.
Quick review of basic nominal patterns.
Complete primary and secondary sections for rigorous grammatical drills.
Essential for mastering morphophonemic shift rules.
The comprehensive classical reference on Sarf.
Cap your Arabic journey with mastery of rhetorical aesthetics.

books.title: Durus al-Lughat al-Arabiyyah (Madinah Book 1)
books.titleArabic: دروس اللغة العربية لغير الناطقين بها - الجزء الأول
books.author: Dr. V. Abdur Rahim
books.description: The premier foundational textbook taught at the Islamic University of Madinah. Teaches basic Arabic grammar and vocabulary using an immersive intuitive approach.

books.title: Matn al-Ajrumiyyah with Vocalized Text
books.titleArabic: متن الآجرومية في علم النحو مشكولاً كاملاً
books.author: Ibn Ajurrum as-Sanhaji
books.description: The famous 7th-century Moroccan grammar poem that forms the bedrock of classical Nahw studies across the Islamic world.

books.title: Al-Nahw Al-Wadih: Primary Part 1-3
books.titleArabic: النحو الواضح في قواعد اللغة العربية للمدارس الابتدائية
books.author: Ali Al-Jarim & Mustafa Amin
books.description: Remarkably clear inductive method presenting examples first, extracting the rule, and providing graded exercises.

books.title: Hans Wehr: Dictionary of Modern Written Arabic
books.titleArabic: معجم هانز فير للغة العربية المعاصرة
books.author: Hans Wehr (Ed. J. Milton Cowan)
books.description: The most authoritative Arabic-English dictionary arranged strictly by Arabic root system. Indispensable for every student.

books.title: Qisas al-Nabiyyeen lil-Atfal (Parts 1-4)
books.author: Abul Hasan Ali Nadwi
books.description: Enchanting graded reader narrating the lives of prophets using pure, elegant Arabic sentence structure suited for language learners.

books.title: At-Tuhfat al-Saniyyah bi-Sharh al-Ajrumiyyah
books.author: Muhammad Muhyiddin Abdul-Hamid
books.description: The gold standard commentary on Al-Ajrumiyyah with comprehensive questions, exercises, and syntactical parsing formulas.

notes.title: All 10 Trilateral Verb Forms (الأوزان العشرة) Cheat Sheet
notes.description: A compact 2-page full color matrix covering forms I through X: past tense, present tense, masdar, active participle, passive participle, and semantic meaning shifts.
notes.author: Ustadh Zayd Farhan

notes.title: Complete Guide to Case Endings (علامات الإعراب الأصلية والفرعية)
notes.description: Color-coded visual mindmap illustrating Raf', Nasb, Jarr, and Jazm across singular nouns, duals, sound plurals, broken plurals, and the five nouns (Asma' Khamsah).
notes.author: Madinah Arabic Study Circle

notes.title: Everyday Particles Reference: Harf Jar, Nasb, & Jazm
notes.description: All common Arabic prepositions, subjunctives, jussives, and conjunctions listed with their governing effects on ensuing words.
notes.author: Br. Tariq Mansoor

notes.title: Possession & Construct (الإضافة) Rules & Exceptions
notes.description: Definite and indefinite mudhaf/mudhaf ilayh chains, dropped nun in dual and sound plurals, and pronoun attachments explained with clear diagrams.
notes.author: Institute of Quranic Studies

notes.title: Pronouns Matrix: Detached, Attached, and Hidden (الضمائر)
notes.description: Full 14-person pronoun paradigm for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd person (masculine, feminine, singular, dual, plural) with examples in nominative, accusative, and genitive.
notes.author: Dr. Fatima Az-Zahra

categories.name: Nahw (Syntax)
categories.description: Classical Arabic syntax, sentence mechanics, case endings (I'rab), and grammatical structures.

categories.name: Sarf (Morphology)
categories.description: Word derivation patterns, root systems, 10 verb forms, and noun templates.

categories.name: Balagha (Rhetoric)
categories.description: Sciences of Bayan (metaphor), Ma'ani (semantics), and Badi' (literary ornamentation).

categories.name: Quranic Arabic
categories.description: Linguistic breakdown, vocabulary, and grammar applied directly to the Holy Quran.

categories.name: Conversational
categories.description: Active spoken Modern Standard Arabic for dialogues, media, and daily interactions.

categories.name: Reading & Literature
categories.description: Graded readers, classical stories, biographical collections, and anthologies.

categories.name: Tajweed & Phonetics
categories.description: Correct pronunciation, Makharij al-Huruf, characteristics of letters, and recitation rules.

categories.name: Dictionaries & Lexicons
categories.description: Comprehensive classical Arabic lexicons, root-based dictionaries, and student glossaries.

categories.name: Grammar
categories.description: Introductory and foundational grammar rules for early learners.

categories.name: Literature
categories.description: Classical and modern literary treatises, poetry, and prose.

categories.name: Vocabulary
categories.description: Thematic vocabulary lists, flashcards, and frequency dictionaries.
